Bad Experience with Zoloft
I thought Zoloft would create the same euphoria other anti-depressants produce.  I swallowed about 50mg and after about an hour there were minimal effects.  I tried snorting the rest.  Bad choice.  Immediately after snorting, my nose, throat, and eyes began to swell and burn.  My eyes began to water and turn a deep red.  The pain and swelling began to increase after about 10 min although I continued to flush my eyes and nose with water.  The pain was constant for about 2.5 hrs until it gradually decreased.  After about 24 hrs I still sounded like I had a cold.  As for my attempt to use Zoloft to create euphoria, I did not learn till later that Zoloft is time released and not used for fast acting relif (like Xanax).
